'''Kevin James''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Pastimes tournament]] on 4 March 2001 with DS2 / It's Operational / Imperial Command, according to Edmund Gray's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1840">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-pastimes-3-4-01d1840/ pastimes-3-4-01], DeckTech (edmund "edmund" gray, 5 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-pastimes-3-4-01d1840/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
